title: Create: Rewired
description: A modpack containing all the mods you need for the Create: Rewired SMP
body:
![Create: Rewired](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7937014bf92875c452e35036a8e2f048e273117b.png)

**Create: Rewired** is a **Fabric 1.20.1** _SMP-focused_ modpack built around Create and some fun addons put together, designed for multiplayer survival, engineering creativity, and long-term worlds.

![AutoSorter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c443b65cde616c9e2b79e1ec43bf8d3ffdb0e34d.png)

## This pack is all about:

- Mechanical automation
- Rail networks & logistics
- Moving contraptions & airships
- Social SMP gameplay with proximity voice chat
- High performance & server stability

![Windmill](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e04625cc913cfa777aafca5a181b47ca23b20f30.jpeg)

### Core Technology Mods

- Create (Fabric) – rotational power, contraptions, automation
- Create Crafts & Additions – electricity, motors, advanced tech
- Create: Steam ’n’ Rails – trains, signals, rail logistics
- Create: Big Cannons – artillery & heavy engineering
- Create: High Pressure – industrial steam systems
- Create: Numismatics – currency & trading systems

### Physics & Movement

- Valkyrien Skies – physics-based ships & vehicles
- Clockwork – Create + Valkyrien Skies integration
- Crawl - To crawl duh... _pretty self explanatory_

### Multiplayer & SMP Features (optional)

- Simple Voice Chat – proximity voice for real SMP vibes
- Jade – in-world block & machine info

### Discord Server
- https://discord.gg/63JyUuDWNT (applications to this SMP will apply)

### Note
As of now FTB mods (FTB Quests, FTB Library etc.) is not published on Modrinth so it cannot be added in this modpack so please either download this from [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/create-rewired) or download the mods from the link below, for more support please join our Discord Server.
